name: Lillia
title: the Bashful Bloom

Q.name: Blooming Blows
Q.description: Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant 0.03/0.04/0.05/0.06/0.07 + 0.0×AP Move Speed for 6.5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing 35/45/55/65/75 + 0.35×AP magic damage, plus an additional 35/45/55/65/75 + 0.35×AP true damage at the outer edge.
Q.summary: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

W.name: Watch Out! Eep!
W.description: Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 + 0.35×AP magic damage. Enemies in the center take (80/100/120/140/160 + 0.35×AP) × 3 damage instead.
W.summary: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

E.name: Swirlseed
E.description: Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 + 0.5×AP magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.
E.summary: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

R.name: Lilting Lullaby
R.description: Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for 1.5 seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for 2.5/2.75/3 seconds. When awakened by damage, they take an additional 100/150/200 + 0.4×AP magic damage.
R.summary: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

Passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
Passive.description: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.
Passive.summary: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: AP skirmisher jungler (also top) who stacks move speed with every ability hit and kites in circles with Q. Wins fights by sleeping every Dream Dust target with R.
strengths: Q passive move speed stacks with every ability hit: kites melee champions for a long time
R sleeps every champion marked with Dream Dust: teamfight-wide crowd control
Q outer edge deals true damage; passive deals max-health damage to tanks
Long-range E seed slows and reveals, rolls on if it misses
weaknesses: Squishy: dies to burst and point-and-click crowd control
W centre (triple damage) is hard to land on moving targets
Early ganks are weak before R (only E slow)
No dash: relies on move speed to escape
R needs Dream Dust on targets first (an ability hit)

curve.lvl1: medium – strong Q clear, but squishy in invades
curve.lvl2: medium – Q + W clears; still no hard crowd control
curve.lvl3: medium – E slow ganks with Q move speed
curve.lvl6: strong – R sleep: real ganks and teamfights
curve.items: strong – Liandry's Torment: max-health burn with passive, big with Riftmaker/Rylai's

profile.curveNote: Ganks before 6 rely on E slow; R sleep is what makes her ganks and fights land.
profile.sustain: low – passive heals a bit on monsters; Liandry/omnivamp
profile.mobility: high – stacking Q move speed (no dash)

Passive.notes: Ability hits apply Dream Dust: max-health damage over time (marks targets for R).

Q.notes: Whirl around her; outer edge deals bonus true damage. Passive: move speed per ability hit.

W.notes: Delayed strike; centre deals triple damage.

E.notes: Lobbed seed: damage, reveal and slow; rolls until it hits if it misses.

R.notes: All Dream Dust champions become Drowsy (slowed), then Asleep; damage wakes them for bonus damage.

profile.windowAgainst: R down, or before she has stacked move speed: catch her with crowd control and burst her.
checks: E: seed is lobbed overhead; treated as not a projectile (blockability unconfirmed).
R Drowsy treated as a slow.
